title: Triage to Autonomy: 30-day Onboard Compact & Interview Probe Matrix
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact playbook and working matrix intended to shorten the path from interview-to-autonomy for new hires (esp. infra/platform/serving-runtime engineers). The doc combines: a lightweight hiring checklist, an interview probe matrix focused on probation-evidence, and a focused 30-day activation contract between manager, mentor, and hire.

What this is (quick):
- A one-page compact for hiring managers + recruiters to set expectations before offer acceptance.
- A short rubric for interviewers to capture evidence mapped to 30-day onboarding outcomes.
- A concrete 30-day activation agreement with weekly milestones and ownership handoffs.

Principles:
- Evidence-first: every interview probe should map to a concrete 30d task we can validate.
- Minimal friction: reduce non-value admin in week 0 (access, tooling, signal collection).
- Mentor-led triage: mentor owns day-to-day activation; manager owns goals and resourcing.
- Safety nets: define explicit fallbacks for access, infra, and blockers.

Hiring checklist (pre-offer):
- Role brief updated (1 paragraph core responsibility + 3 key initial outcomes).
- Must-have competencies listed in candidate packet (systems debugging, infra IaC, incident triage).
- Hiring packet sent to candidate includes: 30d activation draft, manager expectations, mentor intro slot.
- Interview slate includes at least one exercise that produces a 30d-evidence artifact (e.g., small debugging ticket).
- Recruiter confirms candidate timezone, remote hardware needs, and first-week availability.

Interview probe matrix (short):
Each probe -> evidence artifact -> 30d validation task
- Systems debugging (probe): walk through a noisy node incident.
  Evidence: step-by-step incident notes and proposed mitigation.
  30d task: own a postmortem draft for a small infra incident.
- Code hygiene / infra-as-code (probe): change to a CI job / Terraform patch.
  Evidence: PR with clear description and test plan.
  30d task: ship a small infra change and update runbook.
- Ownership & communication (probe): scenario where a service degrades mid-release.
  Evidence: proposed comms + escalation plan.
  30d task: be primary on one oncall rotation shadow + run 1 pager.
- Debugging latency issues (probe): analyze perf trace.
  Evidence: short heatmap, root-cause hypothesis, cheap mitigations.
  30d task: implement and validate a latency regression alert rule.

Scoring guide for interviewers (quick):
- 3: Clear, repeatable approach; produced an artifact in-session or very specific plan.
- 2: Sound technical instincts but missing follow-through or edge-case handling.
- 1: Needs coaching on core area; relies on vague handwavy solutions.
- Note: capture the explicit artifact link or a short bullet so onboarding team can re-use it.

30-day activation contract (template to share in offer folder)
- Objective (manager + hire): By day 30 the hire will be able to independently triage a low-to-medium severity incident and land a small infra change to production with tests and runbook update.
- Week 0 (days 0–3): access checklist, welcome sync, mentor pairing, 1 prioritized reading list items.
  Deliverables: working laptop + credentials, calendar invites for onboarding sequence, intro PR to team channel.
- Week 1 (days 4–10): shadow oncall, run through a local dev-to-prod flow, complete one small bug fix.
  Deliverables: bug-fix PR merged, short retrospective notes to mentor.
- Week 2 (days 11–17): take ownership of a small ticket end-to-end (from ticket triage to deploy).
  Deliverables: merged PR, deploy notes, updated runbook snippets.
- Week 3 (days 18–24): lead a short incident triage under mentor observation; propose a low-risk improvement.
  Deliverables: triage notes + improvement RFC (one-pager).
- Week 4 (days 25–30): independent rotation on a low-risk oncall window; finalize 30d report with manager.
  Deliverables: 30d report (signals, blockers, goals for 60d), paired handoff with mentor.

Manager responsibilities (short):
- Approve the 30d contract before offer is sent.
- Ensure mentor availability and scheduled 1:1s (3 during 30d).
- Clear success criteria and an escalation path if hire is blocked.
- Weekly check-ins: should be factual and evidence-oriented.

Mentor responsibilities (short):
- Daily stand-ups weeks 0–2 (light, 15m), then alternate days.
- Curate a short list of micro-tasks that map to interview artifacts.
- Provide PR reviews within 24–48h for onboarding PRs.
- Keep an async log of blockers and remediation steps.

Signals of success by day 30 (observable):
- Can independently open/close a small ticket with production impact < low.
- Has one merged infra PR and updated runbook content.
- Can summarize an incident end-to-end and propose mitigations.
- Has documented learning items and a prioritized 60d goal list.

Remediation path (if not on track):
- At day 14: checkpoint with written evidence; define one focused coaching sprint (7 days).
- If insufficient progress at day 30: convert to a 30-day probation plan with explicit expectations and weekly evidence deliverables.

Operational notes / quick templates (copy-paste in offer):
- 30d Activation Agreement (to sign): manager / mentor / hire = agree to objectives and weekly syncs.
- Week 1 script for mentor: 0) tech setup check 1) quick repo tour 2) shadow PR flow 3) triage runbook intro.
- Day 30 report template (one paragraph + 3 data points): wins, blockers, 60d goals.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Should recruiting require the candidate to complete a short take-home that maps directly to a 30d task? (pro/con notes).
- Add checklist entries for hardware reimbursements and remote networking (VPN) automated pre-checks.
- Coordinate with SRE on a guaranteed small incident candidate can own for evidence capture.

Notes to self / shorthand items:
- Re-use existing interview probes but append "evidence artifact" field.
- Share with recruiting + hiring managers next Wed; ask for two pilot hires.
- Aim to reduce average time-to-primary-contribution from 55 days -> 30 days for infra hires.

End.
